methods.returns: The output pad of the video mixer for connecting to the pipeline.

methods.name: AddAudioSource
methods.summary: Adds the configured audio source to the capture pipeline and returns its output pad. Determines the audio source type from Audio_Source property and creates the appropriate audio source block. Supports system audio devices, virtual sources, audio mixers, and professional hardware.
methods.returns: The output pad of the audio source if successful; otherwise, null if source creation or configuration fails.

methods.name: AddAudioSourceVirtual
methods.summary: Adds a virtual audio source that generates synthetic test tones, silence, or noise without requiring physical devices. Useful for testing audio processing pipeline, creating placeholder audio, or generating reference tones. Supports sine wave, white noise, pink noise, and silence generation.

parameters.name: virtualAudio
parameters.summary: The virtual audio source settings including wave type, frequency, sample rate, channels, and amplitude.

methods.returns: The output pad of the virtual audio source for connecting to the pipeline.

methods.name: AddInternalAudioSource
methods.summary: Adds a bridge audio source for inter-pipeline audio data sharing using shared memory. Allows receiving audio from another pipeline or process through named shared memory buffers. Used for advanced scenarios requiring audio data exchange between separate SDK instances or applications.

parameters.name: internalAudio
parameters.summary: The bridge audio source settings including shared memory name and audio format parameters.

methods.returns: The output pad of the bridge audio source for connecting to the pipeline.

methods.name: AddAudioSourceCaptureDevice
methods.summary: Adds a system audio capture device source such as microphones, line-in ports, or system audio. Uses platform-specific APIs (WASAPI/DirectSound on Windows, CoreAudio on macOS/iOS, ALSA/PulseAudio on Linux) to access audio capture hardware. Supports device selection, format configuration, and volume control.

parameters.name: settings
parameters.summary: The audio capture device settings including device selection, sample rate, channels, and audio format.

methods.returns: The output pad of the audio capture device for connecting to the pipeline.

methods.name: AddAudioMixerSource
methods.summary: Adds an audio mixer source that combines multiple audio inputs with individual volume control. Supports mixing multiple audio streams from different sources, each with independent gain adjustment. Useful for combining microphone, system audio, music, and other audio sources into a single output.

parameters.name: settings
parameters.summary: The audio mixer settings including input sources, individual volumes, and output format.

methods.returns: The output pad of the audio mixer for connecting to the pipeline.

methods.name: AddDecklinkAudioSource
methods.summary: Adds a Blackmagic DeckLink professional audio capture device source for high-quality audio input. Captures embedded audio from SDI/HDMI connections or analog audio inputs on DeckLink cards. Supports multi-channel audio capture with professional audio quality and precise synchronization with video.

parameters.name: settings
parameters.summary: The DeckLink audio settings including device selection, input type (embedded/analog), channels, and sample format.

methods.returns: The output pad of the DeckLink audio source for connecting to the pipeline.

methods.name: Audio_SourcesAsync
methods.summary: Asynchronously enumerates available audio capture devices on the system. Includes microphones, line-in devices, and other audio input hardware.

parameters.name: api
parameters.summary: Optional: Specific audio API to enumerate devices from (DirectSound, WASAPI, etc.). Pass null to use default API.

methods.returns: A task containing an array of AudioCaptureDeviceInfo for all available audio input devices.

methods.name: Video_SourcesAsync
methods.summary: Asynchronously enumerates available video capture devices on the system. Includes webcams, capture cards, virtual cameras, and other video input hardware.
methods.returns: A task containing an array of VideoCaptureDeviceInfo for all available video input devices.

methods.name: Video_Composition_Add
methods.summary: Adds an image to be drawn over the video at the element's position, size and alpha; elements added later are drawn on top. Create the element from an SKBitmap on any platform. The element stays through Stop and reopening until it is removed or the engine is disposed.

parameters.name: element
parameters.summary: The video composition element to add with position, size, and visual properties configured.

methods.name: Video_Composition_Remove
methods.summary: Removes a video composition element from the video stream and releases associated resources. Properly disposes of the associated GStreamer media buffer to prevent memory leaks. The element is removed from the composition manager's collection.

parameters.name: element
parameters.summary: The video composition element instance to remove from the stream.

methods.name: Video_Composition_Clear
methods.summary: Removes all video composition elements from the video stream and releases all associated resources. Ensures proper disposal of all element resources by calling Video_Composition_Remove for each element. Use this to reset video composition to a clean state without individual element removal.

methods.name: Video_Effects_AddOrUpdateAsync
methods.summary: Asynchronously adds a new video effect or updates an existing one in the video processing chain. Effects are applied in real-time to the video stream during capture. If an effect with the same name exists, it will be updated with the new settings. Otherwise, a new effect is added to the processing pipeline.
methods.remarks: A ResizeVideoEffect, crop effect or box cannot be added or updated through this call while the pipeline is started: the outputs were built for the frame size that reached them. The call is refused through OnError and the running graph keeps its frame size; stop the pipeline and add the effect again. Setting a property on an effect object that is already applied is not intercepted and takes effect live.

parameters.name: effect
parameters.summary: The video effect to add or update in the processing pipeline.

methods.returns: A Task representing the asynchronous add/update operation.

methods.name: Video_Effects_Get
methods.summary: Gets a video effect by its name identifier from the video effects chain. Use this to retrieve effect instances for inspection or modification of effect parameters.

parameters.name: effectName
parameters.summary: The name of the effect to retrieve from the processing chain.

methods.returns: The video effect instance if found by name; otherwise, null if no effect with that name exists.

methods.name: Video_Effects_Remove
methods.summary: Removes a specific video effect from the video processing chain by instance reference. A running capture keeps running: the effect is taken out between two frames. A capture that was paused when the removal was requested stays paused. Note: ResizeVideoEffect, the crop effects and box cannot be removed when pipeline is started as they affect the bridge configuration. Remove them before starting or after stopping the pipeline to prevent resolution mismatch issues.

parameters.name: effect
parameters.summary: The video effect instance to remove from the processing chain.

methods.name: Video_Effects_Remove
methods.summary: Removes a video effect by its name identifier from the video processing chain. A running capture keeps running: the effect is taken out between two frames. A capture that was paused when the removal was requested stays paused. If no effect with the specified name exists, no action is taken. Note: ResizeVideoEffect, the crop effects and box cannot be removed when pipeline is started as they affect the bridge configuration. Remove them before starting or after stopping the pipeline to prevent resolution mismatch issues.

parameters.name: name
parameters.summary: The name of the video effect to remove from the processing chain.

methods.name: Video_Effects_Clear
methods.summary: Removes all video effects from the video processing chain, restoring unprocessed video. A running capture keeps running through the clear; a deliberate pause is preserved. Note: If a frame-size effect (ResizeVideoEffect, a crop effect or box) is present and the pipeline is running, the clear operation will be blocked to prevent resolution mismatch issues. Stop the pipeline first before clearing effects if one is in use. Use this to reset video processing to default state without individual effect removal.

methods.name: EditLiveEffects
methods.summary: Runs one live effect edit. A settled Playing pipeline is edited as it runs (GitHub issue #1673); anything else goes through the older discipline: pause, edit, resume. Each state transition is waited out; an un-paused edit and a resume that never lands are logged, which raises OnError.
methods.remarks: Only a pipeline this call takes out of Playing does it put back: read before the pause, and counting an in-flight transition toward Playing as playing - otherwise a removal landing inside someone else's start would interrupt that start to PAUSED and never finish it, the same silent frame stop this whole discipline exists to prevent. A deliberate pause survives the edit, the contract the live-add path keeps (VideoEffectsBlock.Attach). There is nothing to pause on an engine with no pipeline - before the first start or after teardown - so those paths stay quiet rather than logging errors for normal operation. Known gap, accepted and documented rather than locked away: a foreign start whose SetState(Playing) lands between this method's state snapshot and its own Pause() is invisible to the snapshot - current still reads pre-start, pending still reads VoidPending - so the edit pauses over it, cancels it, and never resumes. Distinguishing that from a deliberate pause after the fact is impossible without a lock shared with StartAsync, which costs every caller for a microsecond window only an application removing effects strictly concurrently with starting can open. The unconditional resume this replaced had the mirror-image defect: it lifted deliberate pauses.

parameters.name: opName
parameters.summary: The public operation's name, for log tags.

parameters.name: what
parameters.summary: A noun phrase naming the edit, for both messages.

parameters.name: edit
parameters.summary: The edit itself, handed the effects block (which may be null after a teardown) and responsible for tolerating that.

methods.name: IsFrameSizeEffect
methods.summary: Checks if the given video effect changes the output frame size by type inspection. Resize, the crop effects and box do, and the capture bridge is configured for one resolution, so removing or clearing one during active capture would leave the bridge and the graph disagreeing on the frame size.
methods.returns: true if the effect is a frame-size effect instance; otherwise, false.

methods.name: AddBarcodeReader
methods.summary: Initializes and configures the barcode/QR code detector for real-time detection in the video stream. Sets up the detector in input/output mode to pass frames through while detecting codes. Subscribes to detection events to forward barcode data to the public OnBarcodeDetected event.

methods.name: BarcodeReader_OnBarcodeDetected
methods.summary: Forwards a detection to the handlers subscribed to OnBarcodeDetected at the time it is raised. Subscribing the event itself would hand the block a copy of the handlers present at Start.

methods.name: DetachBarcodeReader
methods.summary: Detaches the barcode detector, so a detection raised from then on does not reach the application; one already being delivered can still finish. Called by ClearPipeline before it stops and disposes the pipeline. The block itself is not disposed here: the pipeline owns it and disposes it once it has stopped - disposing it first takes its elements to NULL while the pipeline is still PLAYING (issue #4171).

methods.name: ProcessFaceTracking
methods.summary: Processes face detection and tracking on the provided video frame using the configured face detector. Checks if the frame format is supported by the face detector before processing. If the format is unsupported, logs an error with supported formats and skips processing.

parameters.name: faceDetector
parameters.summary: The face detector, read once by the caller.

parameters.name: videoFrame
parameters.summary: The video frame to analyze for face detection and tracking.

methods.name: ProcessVideo
methods.summary: Processes the video frame using a custom video processor implementation for frame-by-frame analysis. Verifies the frame format is supported by the processor before processing. If the format is unsupported, logs an error with supported formats and skips processing. Custom processors can perform object detection, image analysis, or frame modifications.

parameters.name: processor
parameters.summary: The video processor to apply to the frame for custom analysis or modification.

parameters.name: videoFrame
parameters.summary: The video frame to process through the custom processor.

methods.name: ReportUnsupportedFormat
methods.summary: Logs, once per pipeline build for each detector or processor, a frame format it does not support.

methods.name: FirstSeen
methods.summary: Records key in table; returns true the first time it is seen.

methods.name: AddMotionDetector
methods.summary: Adds or reconfigures the AForge motion detector based on current motion detection settings. This method initializes the motion detector with the current Motion_Detection properties including detector type (simple, two frames, custom frame, etc.), thresholds, grid settings (for zone-based detection), and highlighting options for visualizing detected motion. Creates a new detector instance if none exists, or reconfigures the existing one with updated settings.

events.name: OnAudioFrameBuffer
events.summary: Occurs whenever a new audio frame is received from the audio capture source. This event provides raw audio data for custom processing or analysis.

events.name: OnVideoFrameBuffer
events.summary: Occurs whenever a new video frame is received in RGBA format from the video capture source. This event provides raw video frame data for custom processing or analysis.

events.name: OnVideoFrameSKBitmap
events.summary: Occurs whenever a new video frame is received and converted to SkiaSharp SKBitmap format. This event is useful for cross-platform image processing using SkiaSharp.

events.name: OnVideoFrameBitmap
events.summary: Occurs whenever a new video frame is received and converted to System.Drawing.Bitmap format. This event is Windows-specific and provides frames in GDI+ compatible format.

events.name: OnError
events.summary: Occurs whenever an error happens during video capture operations. Subscribe to this event to handle and log capture-related errors.

events.name: OnAudioVUMeter
events.summary: Occurs whenever new audio VU meter data is received, providing audio level information. This event is useful for displaying audio level indicators in the user interface.

events.name: OnLicenseRequired
events.summary: Occurs when the current configuration requires a specific SDK license edition. The event data identifies the required Standard, Professional, or Premium edition.

events.name: OnFaceDetected
events.summary: Occurs whenever faces are detected in a video frame during capture. This event provides face detection results including face locations and attributes.

events.name: OnStart
events.summary: Occurs when video capture or playback starts successfully. Use this event to update UI or perform initialization after capture begins.

events.name: OnPause
events.summary: Occurs when video capture or playback is paused. Use this event to update UI state when capture is temporarily suspended.

events.name: OnResume
events.summary: Occurs when video capture or playback resumes after being paused. Use this event to restore UI state when capture continues.

events.name: OnStop
events.summary: Occurs when video capture or playback stops completely. This event provides the final position and allows for cleanup operations.

events.name: OnMotionDetection
events.summary: Occurs when motion is detected in the video stream based on configured motion detection settings. Event args contain detailed motion data including affected regions and motion levels.

events.name: OnBarcodeDetected
events.summary: Occurs when a barcode or QR code is detected in the video stream. Event args contain the decoded barcode data and barcode type information.

events.name: OnMouseClick
events.summary: Occurs when a mouse button is clicked while the mouse highlight overlay is active. Provides screen coordinates of the click. Fires automatically when MouseHighlight is configured, as the mouse hook is auto-subscribed on start.

events.name: OnPreEventRecordingStarted
events.summary: Occurs when a pre-event recording starts (buffer flushed to file).

events.name: OnPreEventRecordingStopped
events.summary: Occurs when a pre-event recording stops (post-event timer expired or manual stop).

events.name: OnOutputStarted
events.summary: Occurs when a capture output (recording or streaming) starts successfully. The event argument contains the index of the output that started.

events.name: OnOutputPaused
events.summary: Occurs when a capture output (recording or streaming) is paused. The event argument contains the index of the output that was paused.

events.name: OnOutputResumed
events.summary: Occurs when a capture output (recording or streaming) resumes after being paused. The event argument contains the index of the output that resumed.

events.name: OnOutputStopped
events.summary: Occurs when a capture output (recording or streaming) stops. The event argument contains the index of the output that stopped. Not raised for an output that Outputs_RemoveAt, Outputs_Remove or Outputs_Clear stops: its file is finalized when that call returns.

classes.name: FallbackSwitchWrapper
classes.summary: Internal wrapper class that indicates a video source should use fallback switch capability. Contains both the original source settings and the fallback configuration for automatic failover. Used internally during pipeline construction to identify sources requiring fallback switch blocks.

constructors.name: FallbackSwitchWrapper
constructors.summary: Initializes a new instance of the FallbackSwitchWrapper class with original and fallback settings.

properties.name: OriginalSource
properties.summary: Gets the original video source settings before fallback switch wrapping. Contains the primary source configuration that will be used when available.

properties.name: FallbackSettings
properties.summary: Gets the fallback switch settings that define the backup behavior. Includes fallback source configuration and failover parameters.

methods.name: CreateBlock
methods.summary: Creates and returns a FallbackSwitchSourceBlock media block instance for the pipeline. The block handles automatic switching between the original source and fallback source.
methods.returns: A new FallbackSwitchSourceBlock configured with the wrapped source and fallback settings.

classes.name: VideoEditCoreX
classes.summary: Cross-platform video editing SDK providing professional non-linear editing capabilities through the timeline editing engine. Supports Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android platforms with timeline-based editing, multi-track composition, real-time effects, transitions, text overlays, and audio mixing. Enables precision frame-accurate editing, smart rendering, and multi-format export for creating professional video content across all major platforms. This is the modern, recommended SDK for video editing in new applications.
classes.remarks: VideoEditCoreX uses the timeline editing engine as its foundation, providing a powerful timeline-based editing model with support for clips, layers, tracks, effects, and transitions. It replaces the legacy DirectShow-based editing solutions and offers true cross-platform compatibility. The timeline belongs to the thread that builds it - the thread of the first Input_* or Start call after construction or after a stop. The Input_* methods, Start, GetSnapshot and the GetDiagramAs* methods must stay on that thread until the session stops; a call from another thread throws InvalidOperationException. The Output_VideoSize, Output_VideoFrameRate, Output_AudioChannels and Output_AudioSampleRate setters work from any thread: from another one the value is stored and applied by the next Start. Stop and Dispose may be called from any thread.

constructors.name: VideoEditCoreX
constructors.summary: Initializes a new instance of the VideoEditCoreX class with a video view for timeline preview. Sets up the editing environment, configures logging, and prepares the video editing pipeline infrastructure.

parameters.name: videoView
parameters.summary: The video view control that will display the timeline preview and playback.

constructors.name: VideoEditCoreX
constructors.summary: Initializes a new instance of the VideoEditCoreX class.

properties.name: Audio_Effects
properties.summary: Gets the collection of audio effects to apply to the timeline during rendering or playback.
properties.value: A list of IVideoEditXAudioEffect objects.

properties.name: Audio_Transitions
properties.summary: Gets the collection of audio transitions to apply between audio clips on the timeline.
properties.value: A list of AudioTransition objects.

properties.name: IsTeardownDraining
properties.summary: Gets a value indicating whether Stop() or Dispose() holds the teardown claim and its drain is not over yet.

properties.name: IsSessionStopping
properties.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the teardown is claimed and the pipeline not yet marked for recreation: the timeline there is the one being destroyed.

properties.name: SmartRender
properties.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to use smart render mode, which avoids re-encoding when possible.
properties.value: true to enable smart rendering; false for full re-encoding. Default is false.

properties.name: Output_Format
properties.summary: Gets or sets the output format and destination settings for the rendered video.
properties.value: An implementation of IVideoEditXBaseOutput specifying the container format, codecs, and file path.

properties.name: Output_VideoSize
properties.summary: Gets or sets the resolution (width and height) of the output video in pixels.
properties.value: A Size structure specifying the output width and height.

properties.name: Output_VideoFrameRate
properties.summary: Gets or sets the frame rate of the output video.
properties.value: A VideoFrameRate object specifying the output frames per second.

properties.name: Output_AudioChannels

properties.value: The number of audio channels. Common values are 1 (mono), 2 (stereo), 6 (5.1 surround).

properties.name: Output_AudioSampleRate
properties.summary: Gets or sets the sample rate of the output audio stream in Hertz (Hz).
properties.value: The audio sample rate in Hz. Common values are 44100 (CD quality), 48000 (professional), 96000 (high-res).

properties.name: Output_VideoCrop

properties.name: Output_VideoRotateFlip

properties.value: A FlipRotateVideoEffect object specifying the rotation and flip operations, or null for no transformation.

properties.name: State

properties.name: Debug_Dir

properties.value: The full path to the debug output directory. Defaults to the user's home folder; on iOS, the app's Documents folder.

properties.name: Debug_DisableMessageDialogs

properties.name: Debug_Telemetry

properties.name: Debug_NativeCriticals

properties.value: true to capture native criticals; false (the default) to capture nothing.

properties.name: SDK_BuildDate

properties.value: A Version object representing the SDK version (Major.Minor.Build.Revision).

properties.name: ConsoleUsage

properties.value: An ObservableCollection`1 of FontDescriptionX objects representing all installed fonts.

properties.value: true to automatically create crossfade transitions between clips; false for hard cuts.

properties.name: Video_Effects

properties.value: An observable collection of IVideoEditXVideoEffect objects.

properties.name: Video_Transitions

properties.value: An observable collection of VideoTransition objects.

methods.name: AddAudioEffects
methods.summary: Applies all audio effects from the Audio_Effects collection to audio clips on every timeline layer. This internal method iterates through all clips with audio tracks and attaches each configured audio effect, enabling real-time audio processing during playback or rendering operations.

methods.name: AddAudioTransitions
methods.summary: Applies all audio transitions from the Audio_Transitions collection to the main timeline layer. This internal method processes each configured transition, creating smooth crossfade effects between audio segments at the specified times, ensuring professional audio mixing without abrupt cuts.

methods.name: AddAudioTransition
methods.summary: Creates and adds a single audio crossfade transition clip to the main timeline layer at the specified time range. This internal method instantiates a timeline transition clip, configures its timing and audio-specific properties, and inserts it into the layer. If the transition cannot be added, an error is logged to the context.

parameters.name: tr
parameters.summary: The audio transition specification containing start time, stop time, and crossfade parameters.

methods.name: GetDiagramAsImage
methods.summary: Renders the current video editing pipeline diagram as a raster image. VideoEditCoreX uses the GStreamer Editing Services (GES) timeline pipeline rather than a MediaBlocksPipeline. This method generates a diagram by exporting the GStreamer pipeline to DOT format and rendering it as a simplified block diagram. The setting is ignored for GES pipelines; the diagram always shows the GES pipeline structure.

parameters.name: options
parameters.summary: Rendering options controlling scale, spacing, colors, and orientation. Pass null to use defaults.

methods.returns: An SKImage containing the rendered diagram, or null if no pipeline is active. The caller owns the image and must dispose it.

methods.name: GetDiagramAsSvg
methods.summary: Renders the current video editing pipeline diagram as an SVG string. VideoEditCoreX uses the GStreamer Editing Services (GES) timeline pipeline rather than a MediaBlocksPipeline. This method generates a diagram by inspecting the GES timeline structure (layers, tracks, clips).

parameters.name: options
parameters.summary: Rendering options controlling scale, spacing, colors, and orientation. Pass null to use defaults.

methods.returns: A complete SVG document as a string, or null if no pipeline is active.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.summary: Releases unmanaged and optionally managed resources used by the VideoEditCoreX instance. This implementation properly disposes the media pipeline, timeline objects, layers, assets, clips, encoding profiles, and progress timer to ensure complete cleanup and prevent memory leaks.
methods.remarks: This method follows the standard IDisposable pattern. When disposing is true, all managed resources including the timeline editing pipeline, asset cache, and clip cache are properly released. The pipeline is set to null state before disposal, and appropriate delays are inserted to ensure clean shutdown.

parameters.name: disposing
parameters.summary: true to release both managed and unmanaged resources; false to release only unmanaged resources.

methods.name: Finalize
methods.summary: Finalizes an instance of the VideoEditCoreX class, performing cleanup if Dispose was not called. This destructor ensures that unmanaged resources are released even if the object is not explicitly disposed, though explicit disposal through Dispose() is strongly recommended for predictable resource cleanup.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.summary: Performs application-defined tasks associated with freeing, releasing, or resetting unmanaged resources. This method releases the editing pipeline, timeline, layers, asset cache, clip cache, and all associated media resources. Call this method when you're finished using the VideoEditCoreX instance to ensure proper cleanup.
methods.remarks: This is the public entry point for disposing the VideoEditCoreX instance. After calling Dispose, the instance should not be used again. The method is safe to call multiple times. Following disposal, the object is removed from the finalization queue for improved garbage collection performance.

methods.name: SetLicenseCertificateAsync
methods.summary: Loads a license certificate into this instance and activates it if the certificate requires activation.
methods.remarks: This is the only public licensing API. The file-path and stream overloads and every license-key method were removed in 2026.5.2, so an application reads the .vflicense file itself and passes the bytes here. The certificate belongs to this instance: call it on every instance you create, before starting it -- licensing one instance does not license another. Without a certificate the instance runs in the 30-day trial.

parameters.name: certificateData
parameters.summary: The bytes of a .vflicense certificate file issued by VisioForge.

methods.returns: A task that completes once the certificate has been loaded and any required activation has run.

methods.name: CheckLicenseOnBuild
methods.summary: Validates the license on build. Sets dsVMREventID. Returns false if build should be aborted.

methods.name: CheckRequiredLicense
methods.summary: Checks and reports the required license level based on the features and output formats being used.

methods.name: GetLicenseRequirement
methods.summary: Calculates the required edition and explanatory message for the current edit configuration.

methods.name: ToLicenseLevel
methods.summary: Converts the numeric requirement level to the public enum.

methods.summary: Gets the Serilog logger instance used by the VideoEditCoreX SDK for structured logging.
methods.remarks: Use this logger for consistent, structured logging throughout your application when working with VideoEditCoreX. The logger is automatically configured based on the Debug_Mode and Debug_Telemetry settings, with different verbosity levels and output targets depending on the mode.
methods.returns: The ILogger instance configured for this SDK instance.

parameters.name: e

methods.name: LoggerClose
methods.summary: Closes the current logger instance and replaces it with a silent logger to prevent further logging.

methods.name: LoggerConfigure
methods.summary: Configures the logger with appropriate settings based on debug mode, including file logging, Sentry integration, and error event handling.

parameters.name: errorEvent
