values.summary: Hardware-accelerated rendering using OpenGL for cross-platform GPU acceleration.

values.name: D3D11
values.summary: Hardware-accelerated rendering using Direct3D 11 for optimal Windows performance.

enums.name: LVCResizePolicy
enums.summary: Defines the resize policy options for video inputs in the Live Video Compositor.

values.name: Letterbox
values.summary: Scales the video to fit within the target rectangle while maintaining the original aspect ratio. Black bars (letterboxing or pillarboxing) are added as needed to fill the remaining space.

values.name: Stretch
values.summary: Stretches the video to completely fill the target rectangle, ignoring the original aspect ratio.

values.name: LetterboxToFill
values.summary: Scales the video to fill the entire target rectangle while maintaining the original aspect ratio. Parts of the video may be cropped to achieve this.

enums.name: OutputBridgeRecord
enums.summary: Tracks the bridge sink and tee sink pad associated with a single LVC output, together with the pool IDs owned by that output. Stored per-output in _outputBridges so Output_RemoveAsync can undo exactly what Output_AddAsync installed without relying on ordinal indexing into _videoBridgeSinks/_audioBridgeSinks or Tee.Sinks — both of which shift whenever another output is added or removed.

values.name: VideoBridgeSink
values.summary: Video bridge sink created for this output, or null for audio-only outputs.

values.name: AudioBridgeSink
values.summary: Audio bridge sink created for this output, or null for video-only outputs.

values.name: VideoTeePad
values.summary: MediaBlockPad returned by _videoTee.AddNewPadLive() for this output's video branch.

values.name: AudioTeePad
values.summary: MediaBlockPad returned by _audioTee.AddNewPadLive() for this output's audio branch.

values.name: VideoSlotId
values.summary: Video output slot ID borrowed from _freeVideoOutputIds/_nextVideoOutputId. -1 when no video slot was allocated.

values.name: AudioSlotId
values.summary: Audio output slot ID borrowed from _freeAudioOutputIds/_nextAudioOutputId. -1 when no audio slot was allocated.

enums.name: LVCMediaType
enums.summary: Defines the media type for Live Video Compositor inputs and outputs. This enumeration specifies whether a compositor component handles video only, audio only, or both video and audio streams. Used to categorize and manage different types of media sources and destinations within the composition pipeline.

values.name: Video
values.summary: Video-only media type. The input or output handles only video streams and will be connected to video processing components.

values.name: Audio
values.summary: Audio-only media type. The input or output handles only audio streams and will be connected to audio processing components.

values.name: VideoAudio
values.summary: Combined video and audio media type. The input or output handles both video and audio streams simultaneously, requiring connections to both video and audio processing pipelines.

enums.name: LVCMixerType
enums.summary: Defines the mixing technology used by the Live Video Compositor for combining multiple video inputs. Each mixer type offers different performance characteristics, platform compatibility, and feature sets. The choice of mixer type affects both processing efficiency and visual quality of the final composition.

values.name: CPU
values.summary: CPU-based software video mixing. Provides maximum compatibility across all platforms but may have higher CPU usage and lower performance compared to GPU-accelerated options. Best for scenarios where GPU acceleration is not available or when maximum compatibility is required.

values.name: OpenGL
values.summary: OpenGL-based GPU-accelerated video mixing. Provides good performance and cross-platform compatibility on systems with OpenGL support. Recommended for most live composition scenarios requiring real-time mixing.

values.name: D3D11
values.summary: Direct3D 11-based GPU-accelerated video mixing (Windows only). Provides optimal performance on Windows systems with DirectX 11 support. Recommended for Windows-based production environments requiring maximum performance.

values.name: Switcher
values.summary: Input switcher mode that selects one input at a time rather than mixing multiple inputs. Provides the lowest resource usage and is suitable for simple input switching scenarios where only one source needs to be active at any given time.

enums.name: EffectEntry
enums.summary: One effect and the filter that carries it in the graph.

values.name: Effect
values.summary: The effect as the application last supplied it. Written under _audioEffectsLock. A swap to another effect type happens only while Filter is null, so a settings handler that reads it under lock (entry) with a filter present sees an effect of the type that filter implements.

values.name: Filter
values.summary: The filter in the graph, or null while the effect is only registered. Read and written under lock (entry).

values.name: Retiring
values.summary: The filter a live replacement is taking out, still in the graph right in front of Filter until the new one is in, or null. Set and cleared inside one AudioConverter) call. Read and written under lock (entry). GitHub issue #2136.

enums.name: BridgeType
enums.summary: Defines the types of bridges available for inter-pipeline communication.

values.name: Bridge
values.summary: General purpose bridge for video, audio, subtitle, or buffer data. Supports dynamic channel updates via UpdateChannel method.

values.name: Proxy
values.summary: Proxy bridge for communication within the same pipeline. Minimal overhead, best for internal routing.

values.name: InterPipe
values.summary: InterPipe bridge for communication across different pipelines in the same process. Zero-copy transfer with support for multiple listeners.

values.name: RSInter
values.summary: Rust-based inter-pipeline bridge for high-performance scenarios. Optimized for low latency and high throughput.

enums.name: MediaBlockAvailabilityState
enums.summary: Whether a block can be used right now on the current machine.

values.name: Available
values.summary: The block can be created and run.

values.name: Unavailable
values.summary: The block cannot be created: a GStreamer element, native package or hardware support is missing.

values.name: RequiresConfiguration
values.summary: The block exists but needs configuration before it can run - credentials, endpoints, models or devices.

enums.name: MediaBlockPropertyEditorKind
enums.summary: The editor a UI should present for one setting.

values.name: Resource
values.summary: A value the host resolves (device, model, credential, stream) - not directly editable.

enums.name: H264InputFormat
enums.summary: The format of the H264 data pushed into H264PushSourceBlock.

values.name: Auto
values.summary: Detected from the data. The first buffer whose format is unambiguous settles it until the pipeline stops. A single NAL unit behind a 3-byte start code can read as AVC as well, and AVC with bytes past its last NAL unit as byte-stream; set the format explicitly when the source is known.

values.name: AVC
values.summary: AVC: every NAL unit behind a 4-byte big-endian length. Converted to byte-stream in place.

values.name: ByteStream
values.summary: Annex B byte-stream: every NAL unit behind a 3- or 4-byte start code. Pushed as is.

enums.name: PipelineDiagramMode
enums.summary: Specifies the level of detail shown in the pipeline diagram.

values.name: HighLevel
values.summary: Shows only MediaBlock nodes and their inter-block connections. Works before the pipeline is built (uses logical pad connections).

values.name: Detailed
values.summary: Shows all pads explicitly with media types, connection details, and pad-level annotations. Mirrors the information a GStreamer DOT export provides.

enums.name: DiagramOrientation
enums.summary: Specifies the flow direction of the pipeline diagram.

values.name: LeftToRight
values.summary: Sources on the left, sinks on the right.

values.name: TopToBottom
values.summary: Sources on the top, sinks on the bottom.

enums.name: DiagramBlockCategory
enums.summary: Visual category for a media block, used to determine header color in the diagram.

values.name: Sink
values.summary: Sink blocks (renderers, file writers, stream outputs).

enums.name: MediaBlockPadDirection
enums.summary: Specifies the data flow direction for a MediaBlockPad, determining whether it receives or sends media data. This enumeration defines the role of a pad in the MediaBlocks pipeline system.

values.name: In
values.summary: Input (sink) pad that receives media data from other blocks. Data flows INTO the block through this pad.

values.name: Out
values.summary: Output (source) pad that sends media data to other blocks. Data flows OUT OF the block through this pad.

enums.name: MediaBlockPadMediaType
enums.summary: Specifies the type of media content that flows through a MediaBlockPad. This enumeration determines what kind of media streams can be connected and processed by the pad.

values.name: Video
values.summary: Video media content including raw video frames, compressed video streams, and image data. Used for pads that handle visual media processing and rendering.

values.name: Audio
values.summary: Audio media content including raw audio samples, compressed audio streams, and audio data. Used for pads that handle audio processing, mixing, and playback operations.

values.name: Subtitle
values.summary: Subtitle and caption data including text overlays, closed captions, and subtitle streams. Used for pads that handle text-based content for accessibility and localization.

values.name: Metadata
values.summary: Metadata and auxiliary data streams that accompany primary media content. Used for pads that handle timestamps, tags, chapter information, and other descriptive data.

values.name: Auto
values.summary: Automatic media type detection that allows the pad to handle any supported media type. The actual media type is determined dynamically based on the connected content.

enums.name: MediaBlockType
enums.summary: Enumeration defining the types of media processing blocks available in the MediaBlocks pipeline system. This includes sources (file, camera, stream), processors (effects, converters, mixers), encoders (H.264, AAC, etc.), and sinks (file writers, streamers, hardware outputs). Each type represents a specific functional category that determines how the block processes and routes media data within the pipeline.

values.name: UniversalSource
values.summary: Universal media source block that can handle various file formats and includes built-in decoders for automatic format detection and decoding of audio/video streams.

values.name: DemuxerSource
values.summary: Demultiplexer source block that separates audio/video streams from container formats without performing decoding, providing raw encoded streams for custom processing.

values.name: BasicFileSource
values.summary: Basic file source block for reading raw media data from files without format detection or decoding, typically used for pre-processed or elementary streams.

values.name: RTSPSource
values.summary: Real-Time Streaming Protocol (RTSP) source block for receiving video/audio streams from IP cameras, streaming servers, and other RTSP-compliant sources over networks.

values.name: RTSPRAWSource
values.summary: Raw RTSP source block that provides unprocessed RTSP stream data without automatic demuxing or decoding, useful for custom processing or analysis of RTSP packets.

values.name: RTMPSource
values.summary: Real Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP) source block for receiving video/audio streams from RTMP servers, CDNs, and live streaming platforms over networks.

values.name: VirtualVideoSource
values.summary: Virtual video source block that generates synthetic video frames programmatically, useful for test patterns, blank frames, or custom generated video content.

values.name: VirtualAudioSource
values.summary: Virtual audio source block that generates synthetic audio signals programmatically, useful for test tones, silence generation, or custom audio synthesis.

values.name: SystemVideoSource
values.summary: System video source block that captures video from platform-specific video devices such as webcams, capture cards, and other system-recognized video input hardware.

values.name: AndroidCamera2Source
values.summary: Android Camera2 API source block that captures video using the modern Camera2 API. Provides full manual sensor control, auto-focus, auto-exposure, zoom, flash, stabilization, and more.

values.name: SystemAudioSource
values.summary: System audio source block that captures audio from platform-specific audio devices such as microphones, line inputs, and other system-recognized audio input hardware.

values.name: PulseAudioSource
values.summary: PulseAudio source block that captures audio from PulseAudio sound server on Linux systems. Uses the pulsesrc GStreamer element for audio capture from PulseAudio devices.

values.name: DecklinkVideoSource
values.summary: Blackmagic Design DeckLink video capture source block for professional video input. Captures video from DeckLink capture cards supporting SDI, HDMI, and analog interfaces.

values.name: DecklinkAudioSource
values.summary: Blackmagic Design DeckLink audio capture source block for professional audio input. Captures audio from DeckLink capture cards with support for embedded and analog audio.

values.name: DecklinkVideoAudioSource
values.summary: Blackmagic Design DeckLink combined video and audio capture source block. Simultaneously captures synchronized video and audio from DeckLink capture cards.

values.name: ScreenSource
values.summary: Screen capture source block that records the desktop screen, specific windows, or screen regions, including support for multi-monitor setups and cursor capture.

values.name: StreamSource
values.summary: Generic stream source block that reads media data from .NET Stream objects, enabling playback from memory streams, network streams, or custom stream implementations.

values.name: StreamSourceWithDecoding
values.summary: Stream source block with integrated decoding capabilities for .NET Stream objects. Automatically demuxes and decodes media streams for immediate playback or processing.

values.name: ImageVideoSource
values.summary: Image-to-video source block that converts static images or image sequences into video streams, supporting various image formats and frame rate configurations.

values.name: ImageSequenceSource
values.summary: Image sequence source block that reads a sequence of images from a folder and outputs them as a video stream. Uses the GStreamer imagesequencesrc element to create video from image sequences with configurable frame rate.

values.name: VideoRenderer
values.summary: Video rendering block that displays video frames on screen using platform-specific rendering technologies, with support for various UI frameworks and display surfaces.

values.name: AudioRenderer
values.summary: Audio playback block that outputs audio to system sound devices, supporting various audio formats, sample rates, and multi-channel configurations.

values.name: VideoSampleGrabber
values.summary: Video sample grabber block that intercepts and captures individual video frames from the pipeline. Useful for frame analysis, thumbnail extraction, or custom video processing without stopping playback.

values.name: AudioSampleGrabber
values.summary: Audio sample grabber block that intercepts and captures audio samples from the pipeline. Enables audio level monitoring, waveform display, or custom audio analysis during playback.

values.name: DataSampleGrabber
values.summary: Generic data sample grabber block for capturing arbitrary media data from the pipeline. Used for intercepting and analyzing non-audio/video streams such as metadata or custom data types.

values.name: DebugTimestamp
values.summary: Debug timestamp block that logs timing information for media buffers passing through the pipeline. Helps diagnose synchronization issues, performance bottlenecks, and timing-related problems.

values.name: ImageOverlay
values.summary: Image overlay block that composites static images or logos onto video frames. Supports positioning, transparency, scaling, and animation for watermarking and branding.

values.name: SVGOverlay
values.summary: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) overlay block for rendering resolution-independent vector graphics onto video. Ideal for dynamic, high-quality logos, icons, and graphics that scale without quality loss.

values.name: Interlace
values.summary: Interlace block that converts progressive video to interlaced format for broadcast and legacy systems. Combines alternating fields for compatibility with interlaced display standards like PAL and NTSC.

values.name: TextOverlay
values.summary: Text overlay block that renders dynamic text onto video frames with customizable fonts, colors, and positioning. Supports timestamps, captions, titles, and real-time text updates for video annotation.

values.name: VideoResize
values.summary: Video resize block that scales video frames to different resolutions using various interpolation algorithms. Supports upscaling, downscaling, and aspect ratio adjustment for format conversion and optimization.

values.name: VideoCrop
values.summary: Video crop block that removes unwanted edges from video frames by specifying crop boundaries. Useful for removing black bars, focusing on regions of interest, or changing aspect ratios.

values.name: VideoAspectRatioCrop
values.summary: Video aspect ratio crop block that automatically crops video to a target aspect ratio. Intelligently removes edges while maintaining the center focus to achieve desired aspect ratios like 16:9 or 4:3.

values.name: VideoBox
values.summary: Video box block that adds colored borders or letterboxing around video frames. Useful for adding black bars, changing aspect ratios, or creating picture-in-picture effects with borders.

values.name: VideoPaddingChanger
values.summary: Video padding changer block that modifies or adds padding around video frames. Adjusts frame padding for alignment, format conversion, or memory layout requirements.

values.name: NVVideoResize
values.summary: NVIDIA hardware-accelerated video resize block using GPU for high-performance scaling. Provides faster video resizing on NVIDIA GPUs compared to CPU-based resizing.

values.name: NVDSDewarp
values.summary: NVIDIA DeepStream dewarp block for correcting lens distortion from fisheye and wide-angle cameras. GPU-accelerated dewarping for surveillance and automotive camera applications.

values.name: VideoMixer
values.summary: Video mixer block that composites multiple video streams into a single output. Supports picture-in-picture, split-screen, and multi-source video composition with configurable layouts.

values.name: VideoMixerSource
values.summary: Video mixer source block representing an individual input to a video mixer. Configures position, size, z-order, and transparency for a single stream in the mixer composition.

values.name: FlipRotate
values.summary: Flip and rotate block that transforms video orientation by flipping horizontally/vertically or rotating. Supports 90/180/270 degree rotations and mirror effects for correcting camera orientations.

values.name: FishEye
values.summary: Fisheye distortion effect block that applies or corrects fisheye lens distortion. Creates artistic fisheye effects or corrects wide-angle camera distortion.

values.name: ColorEffects
values.summary: Color effects block that applies color transformations and adjustments to video. Provides sepia, negative, color isolation, and other artistic color manipulation effects.

values.name: GaussianBlur
values.summary: Gaussian blur block that applies blur effects to video frames using Gaussian algorithms. Creates smooth blur effects for privacy masking, backgrounds, or artistic purposes.

values.name: Deinterlace
values.summary: Deinterlace block that converts interlaced video to progressive format. Removes comb artifacts from interlaced content for improved quality on progressive displays.

values.name: AutoDeinterlace
values.summary: Auto deinterlace block that automatically detects and deinterlaces interlaced content. Intelligently processes interlaced frames only when needed, preserving progressive content.

values.name: Gamma
values.summary: Gamma correction block that adjusts the gamma value of video for brightness and contrast enhancement. Corrects video brightness levels and improves visibility of dark or bright areas.

values.name: VideoBalance
values.summary: Video balance block for adjusting brightness, contrast, saturation, and hue of video. Provides comprehensive color and luminance correction for video quality enhancement.

values.name: ChromaKey
values.summary: The chroma key video effect block.

values.name: Bayer2RGB
values.summary: The Bayer to RGB conversion block.

values.name: Amplify
values.summary: Audio amplifier block that increases or decreases audio volume levels. Provides simple gain adjustment for boosting weak signals or reducing loud audio.

values.name: AudioBalance
values.summary: Audio balance block for adjusting left/right channel balance in stereo audio. Controls the distribution of audio between left and right speakers or channels.

values.name: CompressorExpander
values.summary: Compressor/expander block for dynamic range control of audio signals. Reduces loud sounds and amplifies quiet sounds for consistent audio levels and broadcasting.

values.name: Echo
values.summary: Echo effect block that adds delayed and attenuated copies of audio for echo and reverb effects. Creates spatial depth and ambience by simulating sound reflections.

values.name: Equalizer10
values.summary: 10-band equalizer block for precise frequency-specific audio adjustment. Provides control over 10 frequency bands for detailed audio tone shaping and enhancement.

values.name: EqualizerParametric
values.summary: Parametric equalizer block with fully configurable center frequency, gain, and bandwidth. Offers professional-grade frequency control for precise audio correction and enhancement.

values.name: ScaleTempo
values.summary: Scale tempo block that changes audio playback speed without affecting pitch. Enables time-stretching for slow-motion or fast-forward effects while preserving audio quality.

values.name: Pitch
values.summary: The pitch shift block for audio pitch adjustment.

values.name: Volume
values.summary: Volume adjustment block for controlling overall audio loudness levels. Provides fine-grained volume control with mute capability for audio mixing and playback.

values.name: VUMeter
values.summary: VU (Volume Unit) meter block for real-time audio level monitoring and visualization. Measures and reports peak and RMS audio levels for monitoring and metering applications.

values.name: NullRenderer
values.summary: Null renderer block that consumes media data without displaying or outputting it. Useful for testing pipelines, driving playback, or discarding unwanted streams.

values.name: SuperBlock
values.summary: SuperBlock container that encapsulates multiple MediaBlocks into a single reusable component. Enables creating complex, pre-configured processing chains as modular, reusable units.

values.name: BarcodeDetector
values.summary: Barcode detector block that identifies and decodes 1D barcodes (UPC, EAN, Code128, etc.) from video frames. Enables real-time barcode scanning for inventory, retail, and logistics applications.

values.name: DataMatrixDecoder
values.summary: The DataMatrix decoder block for detecting and decoding DataMatrix 2D barcodes.

values.name: Tee
values.summary: Tee block that splits a single media stream into multiple identical output streams. Enables sending the same data to multiple destinations for parallel processing or redundancy.

values.name: Queue
values.summary: Queue block that provides buffering and decoupling between pipeline elements. Smooths data flow, prevents stalling, and enables multi-threaded pipeline execution.

values.name: LiveSync
values.summary: The livesync block for live stream synchronization.

values.name: ParseBin
values.summary: Parse bin block that automatically detects and parses elementary streams without decoding. Identifies stream format and prepares it for decoding or direct processing.

values.name: DecodeBin
values.summary: Decode bin block that automatically selects and configures appropriate decoders for media streams. Provides automatic codec detection and decoding for various audio and video formats.

values.name: SubtitleOverlay
values.summary: Subtitle overlay block that renders subtitle text onto video frames. Supports various subtitle formats (SRT, ASS, SSA) with customizable styling and positioning.

values.name: SubtitleSource
values.summary: Subtitle source block that reads subtitle files and provides subtitle streams. Loads and parses subtitle files for synchronization with video content.

values.name: H264Encoder
values.summary: H.264/AVC video encoder block for high-quality, efficient video compression. Industry-standard codec for video streaming, broadcasting, and file storage with wide compatibility.

values.name: HEVCEncoder
values.summary: H.265/HEVC video encoder block for next-generation video compression with improved efficiency. Provides up to 50% better compression than H.264 while maintaining quality, ideal for 4K and HDR content.

values.name: AACEncoder
values.summary: AAC (Advanced Audio Coding) encoder block for high-quality, efficient audio compression. Modern audio codec providing superior quality to MP3 at similar bitrates, widely used in streaming and broadcasting.

values.name: ADPCMCEncoder
values.summary: ADPCM audio encoder block for compressed audio with low computational requirements. Useful for embedded systems, telephony, and applications requiring simple, fast audio compression.

values.name: ALAWEncoder
values.summary: A-law/G.711 audio encoder block for telephony and voice communication applications. Standard codec for PSTN and VoIP systems with 8-bit logarithmic compression.

values.name: AptXEncoder
values.summary: The AptX encoder block for Bluetooth audio encoding.

values.name: AptXDecoder
values.summary: The AptX decoder block for Bluetooth audio decoding.

values.name: MP4Sink
values.summary: MP4/MPEG-4 container sink block for creating MP4 video files. Widely compatible container format supporting H.264, HEVC, AAC, and multiple streams for web, mobile, and desktop playback.

values.name: MXFSink
values.summary: MXF (Material Exchange Format) container sink block for professional broadcast and post-production workflows. Industry-standard format for archiving, editing, and exchanging professional media content.

values.name: MPEGTSSink
values.summary: MPEG-TS (Transport Stream) container sink block for broadcast and streaming applications. Standard format for digital television broadcasting, IPTV, and live streaming with error resilience.

values.name: MPEGPSSink
values.summary: MPEG-PS (Program Stream) container sink block for DVD and similar applications. Container format designed for reliable media storage with multiplexed audio and video streams.

values.name: ASFSink
values.summary: ASF/WMV container sink block for creating Windows Media files. Microsoft's container format supporting WMV video and WMA audio for Windows-based applications.

values.name: EFLVSink
values.summary: The Enhanced FLV (Flash Video) sink block using eflvmux for Enhanced RTMP (V2) with multi-track support.

values.name: PNGEncoder
values.summary: The PNG encoder block based on rspngenc for high-quality PNG image compression.

values.name: HEVCDecoder
values.summary: The HEVC decoder block supporting multiple implementations (FFmpeg, NVIDIA, QSV, AMF, D3D11, VAAPI).

values.name: AV1Decoder
values.summary: The AV1 decoder block supporting multiple implementations (dav1d, av1dec, hardware).

values.name: OpticalAnimationBW
values.summary: The optical animation video effect block.

values.name: MovingBlur
values.summary: The moving blur video effect block.

values.name: WaterRipple
values.summary: The water ripple video effect block.

values.name: ChebyshevBandPassReject
values.summary: Chebyshev band pass and band reject audio effect block.

values.name: ChebyshevLimit
values.summary: Chebyshev low pass and high pass audio effect block.

values.name: WeightedChannelMix
values.summary: Weighted channel mix block for dual-mono audio mixing. Mixes left and right channels with adjustable weights for karaoke vocal control.

values.name: RemoveSilence
values.summary: Remove silence audio effect block that detects and removes silent sections from audio.

values.name: SilenceDetector
values.summary: Silence detector block that analyzes audio streams to detect and report silence periods with configurable threshold and duration settings. Provides real-time callbacks and JSON export of detected silence periods with timestamps.

values.name: CsoundFilter
values.summary: Csound audio filter block for advanced audio synthesis and processing using Csound DSP engine.

values.name: LibVisualCorona
values.summary: LibVisual Corona audio visualizer block that creates sun-like corona effects synchronized to audio.

values.name: LibVisualInfinite
values.summary: LibVisual Infinite audio visualizer block that creates flowing infinite patterns synchronized to audio.

values.name: LibVisualJakdaw
values.summary: LibVisual Jakdaw audio visualizer block that creates Jakdaw-style visualization patterns synchronized to audio.

values.name: LibVisualJess
values.summary: LibVisual Jess audio visualizer block that creates Jess-style visualization patterns synchronized to audio.

values.name: LibVisualLVAnalyzer
values.summary: LibVisual LV Analyzer audio visualizer block that creates analyzer-style frequency display synchronized to audio.

values.name: LibVisualLVScope
values.summary: LibVisual LV Scope audio visualizer block that creates scope-style waveform display synchronized to audio.

values.name: LibVisualOinksie
values.summary: LibVisual Oinksie audio visualizer block that creates Oinksie-style visualization patterns synchronized to audio.

values.name: LibVisualBumpscope
values.summary: LibVisual Bumpscope audio visualizer block that creates bump scope visualization patterns synchronized to audio.

values.name: GLBlur
values.summary: Blur with 9x9 separable convolution OpenGL block.

values.name: GLLumaCrossProcessing
values.summary: The luma cross processing OpenGL block.

values.name: GLSinCity
values.summary: The sin city movie gray-red OpenGL block.

values.name: GLVideoConverter
values.summary: The OpenGL video format converter block.

values.name: D3D11Uploader
values.summary: The Direct3D 11 video frame uploader block.

values.name: D3D11Downloader
values.summary: The Direct3D 11 video frame downloader block.

values.name: OSXAudioSource
values.summary: MacOS audio source. Retired: no block reports this type any more - macOS audio capture is SystemAudioSourceBlock configured with OSXAudioSourceSettings. The value is kept so the enumeration is never renumbered.

values.name: MetalVideoCompositor
values.summary: The Metal video compositor block (macOS/iOS GPU-accelerated).

values.name: MetalVideoFilter
values.summary: The Metal GPU-accelerated video filter block (macOS/iOS).

values.name: MetalConvertScale
values.summary: The Metal GPU-accelerated format conversion and scaling block (macOS/iOS).

values.name: MetalTransform
values.summary: The Metal GPU-accelerated video transform block (macOS/iOS).

values.name: MetalOverlay
values.summary: The Metal GPU-accelerated image overlay block (macOS/iOS).

values.name: VirtualCameraSink
values.summary: The Virtual Camera sink block. Streams video and audio to the VisioForge Virtual Camera via shared memory.

values.name: SpinnakerSource
values.summary: The Spinnaker cameras (FLIR) source (available as plugin and custom redist).

values.name: CustomMixerSource
values.summary: The custom mixer source block that accepts pushed video/audio frames.

values.name: AWSS3HLSSink
values.summary: The AWS S3 HLS sink block.

values.name: RaspberryPiSource
values.summary: The Raspberry Pi camera source block using rpicamsrc.

values.name: H264PushSource
values.summary: The H264 push source block for pushing encoded H264 data.

values.name: FaceDetectorMLKit
values.summary: The ML Kit face detector block.

values.name: EFLVOutput
values.summary: The Enhanced FLV output block using eflvmux for Enhanced RTMP (V2) with multi-track support.

values.name: VideoScale
values.summary: Video scale block that resizes video frames with various scaling methods.

values.name: UniversalSourceBlockV2
values.summary: Universal source block with custom pipeline creation.

values.name: SimpleVideoMark
values.summary: Simple video mark block that embeds invisible watermarks into video streams for identification and tracking. Uses GStreamer's simplevideomark element to insert digital marks that can be detected later.

values.name: SimpleVideoMarkDetect
values.summary: Simple video mark detect block that identifies and extracts watermarks from video streams. Uses GStreamer's simplevideomarkdetect element to detect marks embedded by SimpleVideoMark.

values.name: SMPTE
values.summary: SMPTE transition effect block that creates wipe transitions between two video sources. Uses GStreamer's smpte element to perform standard SMPTE transition patterns.

values.name: SMPTEAlpha
values.summary: SMPTE alpha transition effect block that creates wipe transitions with alpha channel support. Uses GStreamer's smptealpha element to perform SMPTE transitions with transparency.

values.name: RSAudioEcho
values.summary: RS Audio Echo effect block using rsaudioecho from rsaudiofx plugin.

values.name: AudioLoudNorm
values.summary: Audio loudness normalization block using audioloudnorm from rsaudiofx plugin.

values.name: AudioRNNoise
values.summary: RNN-based audio noise reduction block using audiornnoise from rsaudiofx plugin.

values.name: EbuR128Level
values.summary: EBU R128 loudness level measurement block using ebur128level from rsaudiofx plugin.

values.name: HRTFRender
values.summary: Head-Related Transfer Function spatial audio rendering block using hrtfrender from rsaudiofx plugin.

values.name: VP8AlphaDecodeBin
values.summary: VP8 alpha decode bin block that automatically decodes VP8 video streams with alpha channel.

values.name: VP9AlphaDecodeBin
values.summary: VP9 alpha decode bin block that automatically decodes VP9 video streams with alpha channel.

values.name: CodecAlphaDemux
values.summary: Codec alpha demultiplexer block that separates VP8/VP9 streams with alpha into color and alpha streams.

values.name: AlphaCombine
values.summary: Alpha combine block that merges color and alpha streams into RGBA/YUVA video.

values.name: RoundedCorners
values.summary: Rounded corners video effect block that adds rounded corners to video frames.

values.name: SRTPEncryptor
values.summary: SRTP (Secure Real-time Transport Protocol) encryptor block for encrypting RTP streams.

values.name: SRTPDecryptor
values.summary: SRTP (Secure Real-time Transport Protocol) decryptor block for decrypting SRTP streams.

values.name: PanZoom
values.summary: Pan and zoom video effect block that applies zoom and pan transformations to video frames using Cairo.

values.name: BluRaySource
values.summary: Blu-Ray disc source block for high-definition optical disc playback with title, chapter, and stream selection.

values.name: WHIPSink
values.summary: WHIP (WebRTC-HTTP Ingestion Protocol) sink block for WebRTC streaming to WHIP-compatible servers.

values.name: RISTMPEGTSSink
values.summary: RIST (Reliable Internet Stream Transport) MPEG-TS sink block for low-latency streaming over RIST protocol.

values.name: PreEventRecording
values.summary: Pre-event (circular buffer) recording block that continuously buffers encoded media and writes to file on trigger with configurable pre-event and post-event durations.

values.name: MotionDetection
values.summary: Motion detection using frame differencing (no OpenCV dependency).

values.name: UDPSink
values.summary: UDP raw data sink block for sending data to a single destination.

values.name: UDPMPEGTSSink
values.summary: UDP MPEG-TS sink block for multiplexing audio/video into MPEG-TS and sending to a single UDP destination.

values.name: MultiUDPSink
values.summary: Multi-destination UDP raw data sink block for sending data to multiple host:port destinations simultaneously.

values.name: MultiUDPMPEGTSSink
values.summary: Multi-destination UDP MPEG-TS sink block for multiplexing audio/video and sending to multiple UDP destinations.

values.name: AudioDelay
values.summary: Audio delay block that shifts audio buffer timestamps.

values.name: UDPRAWSource
values.summary: UDP RAW source block that receives a live UDP stream (MPEG-TS, RTP, or raw elementary) and exposes parsed but still-encoded H264/H265 video (and optional audio) without decoding, for passthrough recording or remuxing.

values.name: TSAnalyzer
values.summary: The MPEG-TS analyzer block (PAT/PMT/PSI parsing, per-PID bitrate, PCR and continuity statistics).

values.name: UDPRAWMPEGTSSource
values.summary: Raw MPEG-TS-over-UDP source block that exposes the untouched transport-stream byte stream (188-byte packets) without demuxing, for analysis or passthrough remuxing.

values.name: WebView2Source
values.summary: WebView2 video source block that renders web pages as video.

values.name: ONNXInference
values.summary: ONNX inference block that taps video frames, runs a generic ONNX model via ONNX Runtime, and raises the raw model outputs without altering the video stream.

values.name: YOLOObjectDetector
values.summary: YOLO object detector block that runs a YOLOv8/v11 ONNX model on video frames, decodes the detections, optionally draws them onto the frame, and raises the detected objects.

values.name: OcrTextDetector
values.summary: OCR block that runs a multi-stage PaddleOCR (PP-OCR) ONNX pipeline on video frames, recognizes text, optionally draws the regions onto the frame, and raises the recognized text regions.

values.name: LicensePlateRecognizer
values.summary: License plate recognizer (ANPR/LPR) block that runs the PaddleOCR pipeline and filters the recognized text down to plate candidates, optionally drawing them and raising the recognized plates.

values.name: ObjectAnalytics
values.summary: Object analytics block that performs multi-object tracking, tripwire line crossing, and polygon zone occupancy on top of ONNX object detection, drawing overlays and raising analytics events.

values.name: BackgroundRemoval
values.summary: AI background-removal (matting) block that runs an ONNX segmentation model (for example MODNet) on each video frame to estimate a per-pixel foreground alpha mask, then replaces the background in-place with a blur of the original, a solid color, a static image, or transparency.

values.name: SpeechToText
values.summary: Speech-to-text block that taps the audio stream, segments speech with Silero VAD, transcribes it with Whisper (Whisper.net / GGML) on a background worker, and raises the recognized speech segments. Audio passes through unchanged. Lives in the VisioForge.Core.AI.Whisper assembly.

values.name: AndroidAudioPlaybackCaptureSource
values.summary: Android audio playback capture source block that records the audio played by other apps using the MediaProjection token and the AudioPlaybackCapture API (Android 10 / API 29+).

values.name: FaceRecognition
values.summary: Face recognition (face identity) block that runs a two-stage ONNX pipeline: a face detector (YuNet) locates faces and their five landmarks, each face is aligned and turned into an embedding (SFace / ArcFace), the embedding is matched 1:N against an enrolled face gallery, and the block optionally draws the matched identities onto the frame and raises the identified faces.

values.name: OpenVocabularyDetector
values.summary: Open-vocabulary object detector block that runs a zero-shot detection ONNX model (OWLv2 or GroundingDINO) driven by free-form text prompts, decodes the detections, optionally draws them onto the frame, and raises the detected objects. Prompts can be changed at runtime without rebuilding the pipeline.

values.name: VLM
values.summary: Vision-language model (VLM) block that runs a Florence-2 ONNX pipeline on video frames to produce captions, dense region captions, object detection, OCR, and phrase grounding results from natural-language task prompts, optionally drawing the results onto the frame and raising the generated text and regions.

values.name: VideoEmbedding
values.summary: Video embedding block that runs a CLIP ONNX image encoder on sampled video frames to produce L2-normalized frame embeddings for semantic search, adds them to a frame embedding index, and raises the embeddings. Text queries can be encoded with the matching CLIP text encoder for cosine similarity search.

values.name: PIIRedaction
values.summary: PII redaction block that detects faces (YuNet), license plates (FastALPR detector), and on-screen text (PaddleOCR detection + recognition, with an optional regex filter on the recognized text) and obscures them in-place with a Gaussian blur, pixelation, or a solid fill.

values.name: SpeakerDiarization
values.summary: Speaker-diarization ("who spoke when") block that taps the audio stream, finds local speech turns with a pyannote segmentation ONNX model, turns each turn into a voiceprint with a WeSpeaker/3D-Speaker embedding ONNX model, clusters the voiceprints into stable speaker ids by cosine similarity at end-of-stream, and raises the finalized speaker turns. Audio passes through the block: the tap forces a 32-bit float interleaved sample format, but the sample rate and channel count are left unchanged. Lives in the VisioForge.Core.AI assembly.

values.name: VideoStabilization
values.summary: Real-time video stabilization (deshake) block that removes camera shake by estimating global inter-frame motion with OpenCV optical flow, smoothing the camera trajectory with a causal moving-average window, and warping each frame back onto the smoothed path. Backed by the OpenCV vfdeshake element (Windows only).

values.name: AutoReframe
values.summary: AI auto-reframe block that converts landscape footage into a fixed (typically vertical 9:16) output by running object detection on a sampled stream, following the selected subject, smoothing the crop position over time, and cropping + scaling each frame to the configured output resolution.

values.name: AudioEventDetector
values.summary: Audio event detection block that taps the audio stream and runs a YAMNet (AudioSet, 521-class) ONNX classifier over 16 kHz mono windows to recognize real-world sounds (siren, dog bark, glass break, alarm, music, speech, and hundreds more). It passes audio through unchanged, smooths the per-class scores, and raises audio events with hysteresis so one continuous sound produces a single event with a start/end time rather than a stream of duplicates.

values.name: AMAScaler
values.summary: AMD AMA (Alveo MA35D) hardware video scaler block (Linux only). Resizes video and optionally halves the frame rate on the MA35D media accelerator, wrapping the ama_scaler element in the chain ama_upload ! ama_scaler ! capsfilter ! ama_download so it accepts and emits system memory.

values.name: AndroidUVCSource
values.summary: USB (UVC) camera source block for Android. Streams a camera attached over USB OTG, which the regular system video source cannot reach: Camera2 only sees such devices when the vendor ships the External Camera HAL, and the Java USB API cannot perform the isochronous transfers UVC cameras use. Frames are pulled through a native libusb/libuvc bridge and decoded in the pipeline.

values.name: UniversalAutoDemux
values.summary: The universal auto-demuxer source block variant that probes the input and builds a demuxing graph automatically. Distinct from UniversalDemux, which stays with the classic UniversalDemuxBlock.

values.name: UniversalSourceMini
values.summary: The compact universal source block variant. Distinct from UniversalSource, which stays with UniversalSourceBlock.

values.name: FallbackSwitchSource
values.summary: Source block that wraps one or more candidate sources behind an automatic fallback switch. Previously reported UniversalSource.

values.name: ImageOverlayCairo
values.summary: Cairo-based image overlay block variant. Distinct from ImageOverlay, which stays with ImageOverlayBlock.

values.name: FrameDoubler
values.summary: Frame doubler block that duplicates frames to double the output frame rate. Previously reported VideoConverter.

values.name: CustomColorspaceX
values.summary: Custom colorspace conversion block backed by a user-supplied GStreamer capsfilter. Previously reported VideoConverter, which stays with VideoConverterBlock.

values.name: SqueezebackBlockV2
values.summary: Second-generation squeezeback block. Distinct from SqueezebackBlock.

values.name: PreEventSeparateOutput
values.summary: Separate output wrapper around pre-event recording that exposes the circular buffer as an independent output. Distinct from PreEventRecording, which stays with PreEventRecordingBlock.

values.name: TextOverlaySource
values.summary: Source block that generates video frames from rendered text. Previously reported VirtualVideoSource, which stays with VirtualVideoSourceBlock.

values.name: ImageVideoSourceCairo
values.summary: Cairo-based image-to-video source block variant. Distinct from ImageVideoSource, which stays with ImageVideoSourceBlock.

values.name: UniversalTransform
values.summary: Universal transform block wrapping an arbitrary custom video transform element. Reported by the abstract UniversalTransformBlock base; concrete subclasses inherit it unless they override with their own member. Previously reported Custom.

values.name: UniversalDecoder
values.summary: Universal decoder block selecting a decoder for an elementary stream. Previously reported Custom.

values.name: UniversalDemuxDecoder
values.summary: Decoder stage of the universal auto-demuxer pipeline. Previously reported Custom.

values.name: AppBridgeAudioSink
values.summary: Application-side bridge audio sink block. Distinct from BridgeAudioSink, which stays with BridgeAudioSinkBlock.

values.name: AppBridgeAudioSource
values.summary: Application-side bridge audio source block. Distinct from BridgeAudioSource, which stays with BridgeAudioSourceBlock.

values.name: AppBridgeVideoSink
values.summary: Application-side bridge video sink block. Distinct from BridgeVideoSink, which stays with BridgeVideoSinkBlock.

values.name: AppBridgeVideoSource
values.summary: Application-side bridge video source block. Distinct from BridgeVideoSource, which stays with BridgeVideoSourceBlock.

values.name: StreamSourceWithDecoder
values.summary: Stream source block with an integrated decoder, built on SuperMediaBlock. Previously inherited SuperBlock from its base class.

values.name: LiveSourceSwitchDynamic
values.summary: Dynamic live source switch block that reconfigures its candidate sources at runtime. Distinct from LiveSourceSwitch, which stays with LiveSourceSwitchBlock.

values.name: GPUPixelBeauty
values.summary: GPUPixel beauty-face block (skin smoothing and whitening; face reshape/makeup when a detector is present).

values.name: VideoComposition
values.summary: Engine video-composition overlay block drawing the engines' Video_Composition_* images over the video. Previously reported Custom, which collided with CustomMediaBlock and blocked catalog construction.

values.name: D3D12Interlace
values.summary: Direct3D 12 block converting progressive video to interlaced video on the GPU.

values.name: ClockSync
values.summary: The clocksync block pacing buffers to the pipeline clock at a multiple of real time.

values.name: D3D12FisheyeDewarp
values.summary: Direct3D 12 block dewarping fisheye video on the GPU.

values.name: D3D12Remap
values.summary: Direct3D 12 block remapping video through a UV map on the GPU.

values.name: EquirectangularView
values.summary: The equirectangular view block of VisioForge.Core.OpenGL (EquirectangularViewBlock). Previously reported GLEquirectangularView, which collided with GLEquirectangularViewBlock and blocked catalog construction.

enums.name: MediaBlocksDiagnosticSeverity
enums.summary: Severity of a serialization or validation diagnostic.

values.name: Information
values.summary: Informational message that does not affect pipeline usability.

values.name: Warning
values.summary: Warning: the document can be loaded and run, but something needs attention.

values.name: Error
values.summary: Error: the affected block, connection or document cannot be materialized or run.

enums.name: DecoderStrategy
enums.summary: Decoder selection strategy.

values.name: PreferHardware
values.summary: Prefer hardware decoders when available. It can still pick a Direct3D 11, NVDEC H.264/HEVC, Quick Sync, VideoToolbox, VA-API, V4L2 or OMX decoder that MediaBlocksPipeline.ForceGPUDecodersUsage(false) disabled process-wide. On Android it picks a hardware MediaCodec decoder although the SDK ranks them below the software decoders by default and a source's DisableHWDecoders disables them; use Auto or ForceSoftware to honour that.

values.name: Auto
values.summary: The highest-ranked decoder that accepts the stream.

enums.name: EffectSnapshot
enums.summary: What one effect looks like to a test: its identity, and whether it is in the graph.

values.name: InGraph
values.summary: true when a filter for this effect is in the graph.

values.name: FilterType
values.summary: The type of the filter in the graph, or null when there is none.

enums.name: FrameDecision
enums.summary: The action CancellationToken) takes for a single captured NDI frame. The choice is decided purely from the frame type and the accumulation state (no native calls), so the bail/accumulate state machine can be exercised deterministically in unit tests.

values.name: Continue
values.summary: Ignore this frame and keep probing until the wall-clock deadline.

values.name: AcceptVideo
values.summary: Read the video frame into the result and mark video as captured.

values.name: AcceptAudio
values.summary: Read the audio frame into the result and mark audio as captured.

values.name: Bail
values.summary: Stop probing now and return whatever was captured so far.

enums.name: ProbeState
enums.summary: Mutable per-probe accumulation state driven by ProbeState) and FrameDecision). A plain value type holding no native handles, so the classification/bail state machine is fully unit-testable without an NDI receiver.

values.name: GotVideo
values.summary: Whether a video frame has already been captured.

values.name: GotAudio
values.summary: Whether an audio frame has already been captured.

values.name: ConsecutiveErrors
values.summary: Number of error frames seen consecutively since the last non-error frame.

enums.name: UASLocalMetadataSet

enums.name: Checksum
enums.summary: Checksum used to detect errors within a UAV Local Set packet. Checksum formed as lower 16-bits of summation performed on entire LS packet, including 16-byte US key and 1-byte checksum length. Initialized from bytes value as BytesValue.

enums.name: PrecisionTimeStamp
enums.summary: Precision Timestamp represented in microseconds. Precision Timestamp represented in the number of microseconds elapsed since midnight (00:00:00), January 1, 1970 not including leap seconds. See MISB ST 0601.11 for additional details.

enums.name: MissionID
enums.summary: Mission ID is the descriptive mission identifier. Mission ID value field free text with maximum of 127 characters describing the event.

enums.name: AudioEffectType
enums.summary: Defines the types of audio effects that can be applied to an audio stream.

values.name: Amplify
values.summary: Increases the overall volume of the audio.

values.name: BandPass
values.summary: Filters the audio, allowing only frequencies within a specific band to pass through.

values.name: DownMix
values.summary: Mixes multiple audio channels down to a fewer number of channels (e.g., 5.1 to stereo).

values.name: DynamicAmplify
values.summary: Dynamically adjusts the amplification based on the audio signal's characteristics.

values.name: Equalizer
values.summary: Adjusts the balance between different frequency components of the audio.

values.name: Flanger
values.summary: Creates a swirling, whooshing sound effect by mixing a delayed, phase-shifted copy of the signal with the original.

values.name: HighPass
values.summary: Filters the audio, allowing only frequencies above a certain cutoff to pass through.

values.name: LowPass
values.summary: Filters the audio, allowing only frequencies below a certain cutoff to pass through.

values.name: Notch
values.summary: Filters the audio, attenuating frequencies within a very narrow band.

values.name: PhaseInvert
values.summary: Inverts the phase of the audio signal.

values.name: Phaser
values.summary: Creates a sweeping, comb-filter effect by modulating the phase of the audio signal.

values.name: PitchShift
values.summary: Changes the pitch of the audio without significantly altering its tempo.

values.name: Sound3D
values.summary: Creates a spatial audio effect, making the sound appear to come from different directions.

values.name: TrebleEnhancer
values.summary: Enhances the treble frequencies in the audio.

values.name: TrueBass
values.summary: Enhances the bass frequencies in the audio.

values.name: DMOCompressor
values.summary: Direct Media Object (DMO) Compressor effect, which reduces the dynamic range of the audio.

values.name: DMODistortion
values.summary: Direct Media Object (DMO) Distortion effect, which adds harmonic and inharmonic overtones.

values.name: DMOEcho
values.summary: Direct Media Object (DMO) Echo effect, which creates repeating, decaying reflections of the sound.

values.name: DMOGargle
values.summary: Direct Media Object (DMO) Gargle effect, which modulates the amplitude of the audio signal.

values.name: DMOI3DL2Reverb
values.summary: Direct Media Object (DMO) I3DL2 Reverb effect, simulating reverberation in a 3D environment.

values.name: DMOParamEQ
values.summary: Direct Media Object (DMO) Parametric EQ effect, allowing precise control over specific frequency bands.

values.name: DMOWavesReverb
values.summary: Direct Media Object (DMO) Waves Reverb effect, simulating the natural reverberation of sound in a space.

values.name: ParametricEQ
values.summary: Parametric Equalizer effect, providing detailed control over frequency response.

values.name: Fade
values.summary: Applies a fade-in or fade-out effect to the audio.

enums.name: DSChorusPhase
enums.summary: Specifies the phase difference between the original signal and the modulated signal in a DirectSound Chorus effect.

enums.name: DSChorusWaveForm
enums.summary: Specifies the waveform used for modulating the delay in a DirectSound Chorus effect.

values.name: Triangle
values.summary: Uses a triangular waveform for modulation, providing a linear and often more subtle change in delay.

values.name: Sin
values.summary: Uses a sinusoidal (sine) waveform for modulation, resulting in a smoother and more natural-sounding delay variation.

enums.name: DSFlangerPhase
enums.summary: Defines the phase relationship between the original (dry) signal and the delayed (wet) signal in a flanger effect.

values.name: PhaseNeg180
values.summary: Phase offset of -180 degrees. The LFO starts at its most negative position, creating the maximum initial delay. This produces deep initial notches in the frequency spectrum and a pronounced downward sweep at the start.

values.name: PhaseNeg90
values.summary: Phase offset of -90 degrees. The LFO starts at a negative quarter-cycle position. This creates a moderate initial delay with notches starting in the lower-mid frequency range.

values.name: PhaseZero
values.summary: Phase offset of 0 degrees. The LFO starts at its center (neutral) position. This is the most common setting, providing a balanced flanging effect that sweeps equally in both directions.

values.name: Phase90
values.summary: Phase offset of 90 degrees. The LFO starts at a positive quarter-cycle position. This creates a moderate initial advance with notches starting in the upper-mid frequency range.

values.name: Phase180
values.summary: Phase offset of 180 degrees. The LFO starts at its most positive position, creating the minimum initial delay. This produces shallow initial notches and a pronounced upward sweep at the start.

enums.name: DSFlangerWaveForm
enums.summary: Defines the waveform shape used by the Low-Frequency Oscillator (LFO) to modulate the delay time in a flanger effect.

values.name: Triangle
values.summary: Triangle waveform - Creates linear transitions between minimum and maximum delay values.

values.name: Sin
values.summary: Sine (sinusoidal) waveform - Creates smooth, curved transitions with gradual acceleration and deceleration.

enums.name: DSGargleWaveForm
enums.summary: Defines the waveform shape used to modulate the amplitude in a gargle audio effect.

values.name: Triangle
values.summary: Triangle waveform - Creates smooth, linear amplitude transitions for a softer gargle effect.

values.name: Square
values.summary: Square waveform - Creates abrupt on/off amplitude switching for a harsh, rhythmic gargle effect.

enums.name: AudioFormat
enums.summary: Defines the audio format for raw audio data, specifying whether it is Pulse-Code Modulation (PCM), IEEE floating-point, or encoded. This enumeration is crucial for configuring audio streams and ensuring correct data interpretation throughout the framework.

values.name: PCM8
values.summary: 8-bit unsigned integer Pulse-Code Modulation (PCM) format. This format provides a basic level of audio quality.

values.name: PCM16
values.summary: 16-bit signed integer PCM format. This is a standard format for CD-quality audio.

values.name: PCM24
values.summary: 24-bit signed integer PCM format. Used in professional audio for higher dynamic range.

values.name: PCM32
values.summary: 32-bit signed integer PCM format. Offers even greater precision than 24-bit PCM.

values.name: IEEE32
values.summary: 32-bit floating-point (IEEE 754) format. Commonly used in audio processing to prevent clipping and preserve quality during intermediate calculations.

values.name: Unknown
values.summary: Represents an unknown or unspecified audio format. This value is typically used as a default or to indicate an error state.

values.name: IEEE64
values.summary: 64-bit double-precision floating-point (IEEE 754) format. Provides the highest level of precision for audio processing, though it is less common and more resource-intensive.

values.name: Encoded
values.summary: Indicates that the audio data is in a compressed or encoded format (e.g., MP3, AAC), rather than raw PCM samples.

values.name: Info
values.summary: Informational messages that are useful for tracing application flow and state. This is the most verbose level and is typically used during development and debugging.

values.name: Warning
values.summary: Indicates a potential issue that is not critical but should be brought to the developer's attention. The application can continue to run, but the issue may lead to problems.

values.name: Error
values.summary: Indicates a significant problem or error that has occurred. This level is used for issues that may prevent a specific operation from completing or cause application instability.

values.name: NB

enums.name: KLVDestinationKind
enums.summary: Identifies which KLV destination emitted a KLVPacketEventArgs. A single capture session can have several destinations active at once (e.g. file recording AND network restream); subscribers distinguish them via Destination.

values.name: InProcFFmpegSink
values.summary: In-process FFmpegSink container — fans out to file output (Output_Format = FFMPEGOutput { MPEG_TS_KLV }) and to in-process UDP streaming (Network_Streaming_Format = UDP_FFMPEG with FFMPEGOutput { MPEG_TS_KLV }).

values.name: InProcMpegTsMuxer
values.summary: In-process MPEG-TS muxer — fans out to file output (Output_Format = MPEGTSOutput { KLVEnabled = true }).

values.name: ExternalFfmpegPipe
values.summary: External ffmpeg.exe via named pipe — fans out to file output (Output_Format = FFMPEGEXEOutput { KLVEnabled = true, UsePipe = true }) and to network restream (Network_Streaming_Format = UDP_FFMPEG_EXE with FFMPEGEXEOutput { KLVEnabled = true }).

values.name: AV_CODEC_ID_ADPCM_IMA_ALP

values.name: AV_CODEC_ID_MP3

values.name: AV_CODEC_ID_AAC_LATM

values.name: AV_CODEC_ID_ATRAC3AL

values.name: AV_CODEC_ID_FIRST_SUBTITLE
values.summary: Dummy ID pointing to the start of subtitle codecs.

values.name: AV_CODEC_ID_SAMI

values.name: AV_CODEC_ID_FIRST_UNKNOWN
values.summary: Dummy ID pointing to the start of various fake codecs.

values.name: AV_CODEC_ID_PROBE
values.summary: Codec ID is not known; libavformat should attempt to identify it.

values.name: AV_CODEC_ID_FFMETADATA
values.summary: Dummy codec for streams containing only metadata information.

values.name: AV_CODEC_ID_WRAPPED_AVFRAME

enums.name: GIFResizeStretchMode
enums.summary: Defines how a GIF frame should be resized or stretched to fit a target dimension.

values.name: Stretch
values.summary: Stretches the frame to fill the target dimensions completely, which may distort the original aspect ratio.

values.name: Letterbox
values.summary: Resizes the frame to fit within the target dimensions while maintaining the original aspect ratio. Black bars (letterboxing) will be added to fill any empty space if the aspect ratios do not match.

values.name: Crop
values.summary: Resizes the frame to fill the target dimensions while maintaining the original aspect ratio. The frame will be cropped if its aspect ratio does not match the target, ensuring no black bars are present.

values.name: None
values.summary: The frame is not resized. It will be centered in the output, and if it is larger than the target dimensions, it will be cropped. If it is smaller, the surrounding area will be filled with a background color.

enums.name: VRMode
enums.summary: Specifies the different Virtual Reality (VR) projection modes supported for video playback. Not all modes may be supported by every component (e.g., specific video blocks, effects, or renderers).

values.name: Normal
values.summary: Standard video mode, where no VR projection is applied. The video is displayed as a flat 2D image.

values.name: Equirectangular
values.summary: Equirectangular projection mode, commonly used for 360-degree videos. The video is mapped onto a sphere, allowing the viewer to look around.

values.name: Cubemap
values.summary: Cubemap projection mode, where the 360-degree video is represented as six faces of a cube. This can offer better visual quality at the poles compared to equirectangular projection.

enums.name: LicenseLevel
enums.summary: Defines the different licensing tiers available for VisioForge products. Each level typically unlocks a different set of features or capabilities within the framework.

values.name: Standard
values.summary: The standard license level, typically offering core functionalities.

values.name: Professional
values.summary: The professional license level, providing advanced features beyond the standard offering.

values.name: Premium
values.summary: The premium license level, which usually includes all available features and capabilities.

enums.name: DVDAudioAppMode

values.name: None

values.name: Surround

values.name: Other

enums.name: DVDAudioCaps
enums.summary: Defines the audio format capabilities supported by a DVD player or decoder, represented as bit flags.

values.name: LPCM

values.name: DTS

values.name: SDDS

enums.name: DVDAudioFormat
enums.summary: Specifies the audio encoding format used in a DVD audio stream.

values.name: MPEG1

values.name: MPEG1_DRC
values.summary: MPEG-1 audio with Dynamic Range Compression metadata.

values.name: MPEG2_DRC
values.summary: MPEG-2 audio with Dynamic Range Compression metadata.

values.name: DTS
values.summary: DTS (Digital Theater Systems) compressed audio format.

values.name: SDDS
values.summary: SDDS (Sony Dynamic Digital Sound) compressed audio format.

values.name: Other

enums.name: DVDAudioLangExt
enums.summary: Defines language extension codes that identify special-purpose audio tracks on a DVD.

values.name: NotSpecified
values.summary: No special language extension is specified; this is a standard audio track.

values.name: Captions
values.summary: Audio track contains normal dialog plus additional narration for captions.

values.name: VisuallyImpaired
values.summary: Audio track contains descriptive narration for visually impaired viewers.

values.name: DirectorComments1
values.summary: First director's commentary track providing behind-the-scenes information.

values.name: DirectorComments2
values.summary: Second director's commentary track or alternative commentary.

enums.name: DVDDiscSide
enums.summary: Specifies which side of a double-sided DVD disc is currently being accessed or referenced.

values.name: SideA
values.summary: Indicates Side A of a double-sided DVD disc.

values.name: SideB
values.summary: Indicates Side B of a double-sided DVD disc.

enums.name: DVDKaraokeAssignment
enums.summary: Defines the channel assignment modes for DVD karaoke audio tracks.

values.name: reserved0
values.summary: Reserved for future use. Not currently defined in the DVD specification.

values.name: reserved1
values.summary: Reserved for future use. Not currently defined in the DVD specification.

values.name: LR
values.summary: Left and Right channel assignment. Typically used for stereo instrumental tracks without center channel content.

values.name: LRM
values.summary: Left, Right, and Mono (center) channel assignment. Common configuration where L/R contain instrumental music and M contains guide vocals.

values.name: LR1
values.summary: Left, Right, and channel 1 assignment. Channel 1 typically contains the first guide vocal track for duet songs.

values.name: LRM1
values.summary: Left, Right, Mono (center), and channel 1 assignment. Provides both centered vocals and an additional guide vocal channel.

values.name: LR12
values.summary: Left, Right, channel 1, and channel 2 assignment. Used for duet karaoke where channels 1 and 2 contain separate guide vocals for each singer.

values.name: LRM12
values.summary: Left, Right, Mono (center), channel 1, and channel 2 assignment. Full multichannel configuration supporting instrumental, centered vocals, and two guide vocal tracks.

enums.name: DVDKaraokeContents
enums.summary: Defines the types of audio content that can be present in DVD karaoke channels.

values.name: None
values.summary: No karaoke content present in this channel.

values.name: GuideVocal1
values.summary: Guide vocal track 1 - Primary guide vocals for the main melody.

values.name: GuideVocal2
values.summary: Guide vocal track 2 - Secondary guide vocals for harmony or duet parts.

values.name: GuideMelody1
values.summary: Guide melody 1 - Primary instrumental melody line.

values.name: GuideMelody2
values.summary: Guide melody 2 - Secondary instrumental melody line.

values.name: GuideMelodyA
values.summary: Guide melody A - Alternative or supplementary melody line.

values.name: GuideMelodyB
values.summary: Guide melody B - Second alternative or supplementary melody line.

values.name: SoundEffectA
values.summary: Sound effect A - First set of audio effects or enhancements.

values.name: SoundEffectB
values.summary: Sound effect B - Second set of audio effects or enhancements.

enums.name: DVDSubPictureCoding
enums.summary: Specifies the encoding method used for DVD subpicture (subtitle and menu overlay) data streams.

values.name: RunLength
values.summary: Standard DVD subpicture encoding using run-length encoding (RLE) compression.

values.name: Extended
values.summary: Extended subpicture coding format with additional capabilities beyond standard RLE.

values.name: Other
values.summary: Other or proprietary subpicture coding format not covered by standard specifications.

enums.name: DVDSubPictureLangExt
enums.summary: Specifies the language extension code for DVD subpicture streams, indicating the intended purpose and display characteristics of subtitles.

values.name: NotSpecified
values.summary: Language extension is not specified or unknown.

values.name: CaptionNormal
values.summary: Normal caption subtitles with standard formatting.

values.name: CaptionBig
values.summary: Large-print caption subtitles for visually impaired viewers.

values.name: CaptionChildren
values.summary: Simplified caption subtitles designed for children.

values.name: CCNormal
values.summary: Normal closed captions including dialogue and audio descriptions.

values.name: CCBig
values.summary: Large-print closed captions for visually impaired viewers who also need audio descriptions.

values.name: CCChildren
values.summary: Simplified closed captions appropriate for children, including audio descriptions.

values.name: Forced
values.summary: Forced subtitles displayed regardless of subtitle settings, typically for foreign language segments.

values.name: DirectorCommentsNormal
values.summary: Director's commentary as subtitles with normal formatting.

values.name: DirectorCommentsBig
values.summary: Director's commentary subtitles with large print formatting.

values.name: DirectorCommentsChildren
values.summary: Simplified director's commentary subtitles suitable for younger audiences.

enums.name: DVDSubPictureType
enums.summary: Specifies the type of content contained in a DVD subpicture stream.

values.name: NotSpecified
values.summary: The subpicture type is not specified or unknown.

values.name: Language
values.summary: The subpicture contains language-related content such as subtitles or captions.

values.name: Other
values.summary: The subpicture contains non-language content such as graphics or special overlays.

enums.name: DVDTitleAppMode
enums.summary: Specifies the application mode or special features enabled for a DVD title.

values.name: NotSpecified
values.summary: The title has no special application mode specified.

values.name: Karaoke
values.summary: The title is authored for karaoke applications with special audio and subtitle features.

values.name: Other
values.summary: The title uses a special application mode other than karaoke.

enums.name: DVDTitleInfoParentalLevel
enums.summary: Defines the parental control levels available in the DVD specification for content rating and access control.

values.name: None
values.summary: No parental level is set. The title has no parental control restrictions or the parental control system is not used.

values.name: Level8
values.summary: Parental Level 8 - Adult content with no restrictions. Typically corresponds to NC-17 or X-rated content.

values.name: Level7
values.summary: Parental Level 7 - Mature adult content. Often used for unrated or adult-oriented material.

values.name: Level6
values.summary: Parental Level 6 - Restricted content. Typically corresponds to R-rated material (17+ or with parent).

values.name: Level5
values.summary: Parental Level 5 - Parents strongly cautioned. Material may be inappropriate for children under 17.

values.name: Level4
values.summary: Parental Level 4 - Parental guidance for children under 13. Typically corresponds to PG-13 rated content.

values.name: Level3
values.summary: Parental Level 3 - Parental guidance suggested. Typically corresponds to PG-rated content.

values.name: Level2
values.summary: Parental Level 2 - General audiences with minimal parental concern. Suitable for most children.

values.name: Level1
values.summary: Parental Level 1 - General audiences, all ages. Typically corresponds to G-rated content.

enums.name: DVDValidUOPFlag
enums.summary: Defines User Operation Prohibition (UOP) flags that indicate which user operations are currently prohibited during DVD playback.

values.name: None
values.summary: No operations are prohibited. All user operations are allowed.

values.name: PlayTitleOrAtTime
values.summary: Prohibits jumping to a specific title or time position using time search functionality.

values.name: PlayChapter
values.summary: Prohibits direct chapter selection or jumping to a specific chapter by number.

values.name: PlayTitle
values.summary: Prohibits playing a different title from the current one.

values.name: Stop
values.summary: Prohibits the stop operation, forcing playback to continue.

values.name: ReturnFromSubMenu
values.summary: Prohibits returning from a submenu to the parent menu using the return/back function.

values.name: PlayChapterOrAtTime
values.summary: Prohibits playing from a specific chapter or time position within the current title.

values.name: PlayPrevOrReplay_Chapter
values.summary: Prohibits playing the previous chapter or replaying the current chapter from the beginning.

values.name: PlayNextChapter
values.summary: Prohibits skipping to the next chapter using the "Next Chapter" function.

values.name: PlayForwards
values.summary: Prohibits fast forward scanning through the content.

values.name: PlayBackwards
values.summary: Prohibits reverse scanning or playing backward through the content.

values.name: ShowMenuTitle
values.summary: Prohibits displaying the title menu (main menu) of the DVD.

values.name: ShowMenuRoot
values.summary: Prohibits displaying the root menu (top menu) of the current title.

values.name: ShowMenuSubPic
values.summary: Prohibits displaying the subpicture (subtitle) selection menu.

values.name: ShowMenuAudio
values.summary: Prohibits displaying the audio stream selection menu.

values.name: ShowMenuAngle
values.summary: Prohibits displaying the angle selection menu for multi-angle scenes.

values.name: ShowMenuChapter
values.summary: Prohibits displaying the chapter selection menu (scene selection).

values.name: Resume
values.summary: Prohibits resuming playback from a saved position after entering a menu.

values.name: SelectOrActivateButton
values.summary: Prohibits selecting or activating buttons in interactive menus.

values.name: StillOff
values.summary: Prohibits exiting from a still frame (pause) condition.

values.name: SelectAudioStream
values.summary: Prohibits changing the audio stream using the audio button or direct selection.

values.name: SelectSubPicStream
values.summary: Prohibits changing the subpicture (subtitle) stream using the subtitle button.

values.name: SelectAngle
values.summary: Prohibits changing the viewing angle during multi-angle scenes.

values.name: SelectKaraokeAudioPresentationMode
values.summary: Prohibits changing karaoke audio presentation modes.

values.name: SelectVideoModePreference
values.summary: Prohibits changing video presentation mode preferences.

enums.name: MessageBoxDialogButtons
enums.summary: Specifies constants defining the buttons to display on a message box. This enumeration is used to control the user's interaction options within a dialog.

values.name: AbortRetryIgnore
values.summary: Displays a message box with **Abort**, **Retry**, and **Ignore** buttons.

values.name: CancelTryContinue
values.summary: Displays a message box with **Cancel**, **Try Again**, and **Continue** buttons.

values.name: OK
values.summary: Displays a message box with an **OK** button only.

values.name: OKCancel
values.summary: Displays a message box with **OK** and **Cancel** buttons.

values.name: RetryCancel
values.summary: Displays a message box with **Retry** and **Cancel** buttons.

values.name: YesNo
values.summary: Displays a message box with **Yes** and **No** buttons.

values.name: YesNoCancel
values.summary: Displays a message box with **Yes**, **No**, and **Cancel** buttons.

enums.name: MessageBoxResult
enums.summary: Specifies constants defining the result of a message box dialog. This enumeration is used to identify which button a user clicked on a message box.

values.name: Abort
values.summary: The message box return value is Abort (typically sent from a button labeled Abort).

values.name: Cancel
values.summary: The message box return value is Cancel (typically sent from a button labeled Cancel).

values.name: Continue
values.summary: The message box return value is Continue (typically sent from a button labeled Continue).

values.name: Ignore
values.summary: The message box return value is Ignore (typically sent from a button labeled Ignore).

values.name: No
values.summary: The message box return value is No (typically sent from a button labeled No).

values.name: None
values.summary: The message box return value is None. This is typically used when the message box is closed without a specific button being clicked.

values.name: OK
values.summary: The message box return value is OK (typically sent from a button labeled OK).

values.name: Retry
values.summary: The message box return value is Retry (typically sent from a button labeled Retry).

values.name: TryAgain
values.summary: The message box return value is Try Again (typically sent from a button labeled Try Again).

values.name: Yes
values.summary: The message box return value is Yes (typically sent from a button labeled Yes).

enums.name: MouseButton
enums.summary: Specifies constants that define which mouse button was pressed. This enumeration is used in mouse-related events to identify the specific button involved in the event.

values.name: Middle
values.summary: The middle mouse button (often the scroll wheel button).

values.name: XButton1
values.summary: The first X button (often a side button on gaming mice).

values.name: XButton2
values.summary: The second X button (often a side button on gaming mice).

values.name: Pause
values.summary: The media playback or capture is paused.

values.name: Free

enums.name: RAWBaseVideoInfo

values.name: Height

values.name: Colorspace

values.name: FrameRateNum

values.name: FrameRateDen
values.summary: Gets or sets the denominator of the frame rate (e.g., 1 for 30/1 fps).

enums.name: RAWVideoColorSpace

values.name: Unknown

values.name: RGB

values.name: BGR

values.name: YUY2

values.name: BGRA
values.summary: Blue, Green, Red, Alpha color space. Typically 32-bit (8 bits per channel plus an alpha channel).

enums.name: MediaFileTagTypes

values.name: ID3v1

values.name: ID3v2

values.name: APE
values.summary: APE (Audio Project) tag format, used by Monkey's Audio and other formats.

values.name: Apple

values.name: ASF

values.name: RIFFInfo

values.name: MovieId
values.summary: RIFF Movie ID list tag, specific to some AVI files.

values.name: DivX

values.name: FLACMetadata

values.name: TIFFIFD

values.name: XMP

values.name: JPEGComment

values.name: GIFComment
values.summary: GIF comment tag, a simple text comment embedded in GIF image files.

values.name: PNG

values.name: IPTCIIM

values.name: AudibleMetadata
values.summary: Audible metadata blocks tag, specific to Audible audiobooks.

values.name: AllTags
values.summary: Represents all available tag types. This value can be used to check for the presence of any tag type.

enums.name: VFSizeIntl
enums.summary: Represents an internal size structure defined by its width and height. This struct is primarily used for interoperation with native code due to its sequential memory layout.

values.name: Width
